from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- overall envelope ---
overall_length = 80.0          # X : front face -> rear face
overall_height = 45.0          # Y : bottom face -> top face
overall_width = 35.0           # Z : channel width (extrusion length)

# --- stepped side profile (X,Y) ---
step_x = 20.0                  # X of the step corner
step_y = 20.0                  # Y of the step corner
rear_top_x = 78.0              # X of the rear top corner
rear_top_y = 45.0              # Y of the rear top corner

# --- smooth curved transitions (spline control points) ---
front_curve_pts = [(12.0, 18.0), (16.0, 19.0)]
top_curve_pts = [(30.0, 44.0), (55.0, 45.0)]
rear_curve_pts = [(79.0, 30.0), (78.5, 15.0)]

# --- bottom fillets ---
front_bottom_fillet = 5.0      # generous radius at the front bottom corner
rear_bottom_fillet = 2.5       # small radius at the rear bottom corner

# --- rectangular pocket (blind, from the top face) ---
pocket_length = 30.0           # along X
pocket_width = 20.0            # along Y
pocket_depth = 12.0            # down from the top face
pocket_center_x = 40.0
pocket_center_y = 25.0

# --- through hole (through the full channel width) ---
hole_diameter = 6.0
hole_center_x = 60.0
hole_center_y = 30.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- closed stepped side profile with smooth curved transitions ----
    with BuildSketch() as profile:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # front face (bottom -> step corner)
            Line((0.0, 0.0), (step_x, step_y))
            # front curved transition (step corner -> top face)
            Spline((step_x, step_y), *front_curve_pts, (30.0, overall_height))
            # top face (front curve end -> rear top corner)
            Spline((30.0, overall_height), *top_curve_pts, (rear_top_x, rear_top_y))
            # rear face (rear top corner -> rear bottom corner)
            Spline((rear_top_x, rear_top_y), *rear_curve_pts, (overall_length, 0.0))
            # bottom face (rear bottom corner -> front bottom corner)
            Line((overall_length, 0.0), (0.0, 0.0))
        make_face()

    # ---- extrude the profile to the channel width ----
    extrude(amount=overall_width)

    # ---- generous fillet at the front bottom corner ----
    front_bottom_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
        if e.center().X < 1.0 and e.center().Y < 1.0
    ]
    fillet(front_bottom_edges, front_bottom_fillet)

    # ---- small fillet at the rear bottom corner ----
    rear_bottom_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
        if e.center().X > overall_length - 1.0 and e.center().Y < 1.0
    ]
    fillet(rear_bottom_edges, rear_bottom_fillet)

    # ---- rectangular pocket cut from the top face ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(overall_width)) as pocket_sk:
        with Locations((pocket_center_x, pocket_center_y)):
            Rectangle(pocket_length, pocket_width)
    extrude(amount=-pocket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- through hole through the full channel width ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as hole_sk:
        with Locations((hole_center_x, hole_center_y)):
            Circle(hole_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=overall_width, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
overall_length   = 80.0    # overall length of the channel (X)
overall_height   = 40.0    # overall height of the channel (Y)
channel_width    = 35.0    # width of the channel (Z)
wall_thickness   = 0.6     # thin, uniform wall

# profile control points (X, Y) - outer boundary, then inner boundary
outer = [
    (0.0,      0.0),
    (overall_length, 0.0),
    (overall_length, overall_height),
    (overall_length * 0.6, overall_height),
    (overall_length * 0.4, overall_height),
    (overall_length * 0.3, overall_height * 0.6),
    (0.0,      overall_height * 0.6),
    (0.0,      0.0),
]
inner = [
    (0.0,      wall_thickness),
    (overall_length, wall_thickness),
    (overall_length, overall_height - wall_thickness),
    (overall_length * 0.6, overall_height - wall_thickness),
    (overall_length * 0.4, overall_height - wall_thickness),
    (overall_length * 0.3, overall_height * 0.6 - wall_thickness),
    (0.0,      overall_height * 0.6 - wall_thickness),
    (0.0,      wall_thickness),
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the thin-walled channel by lofting the two profiles
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as s1:
        with BuildLine() as l1:
            Polyline(*outer[:-1], close=True)
        make_face()
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(channel_width)) as s2:
        with BuildLine() as l2:
            Polyline(*inner[:-1], close=True)
        make_face()
    loft()

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_length = 80.0          # overall horizontal length of the body
outer_height = 45.0          # overall height (top of the raised pad)
base_height = 20.0           # height of the lower base section
step_width = 20.0            # horizontal width of the left step
step_depth = 12.0            # vertical height of the step rise
wall_thickness = 2.6        # uniform wall thickness
channel_length = 35.0        # extrusion length of the channel

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the closed outer profile (stepped base + raised pad)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_length, 0))                # bottom edge
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_length, base_height))      # right wall (lower)
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (outer_length - step_width, outer_height))  # sloped right wall (upper)
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (step_width, outer_height))       # top edge of raised pad
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (step_width, base_height))        # left wall (upper)
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, base_height))                 # step shoulder
            l7 = Line(l6 @ 1, (0, 0))                           # left wall (lower)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=channel_length)

solid_body = p.part

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Uniform wall thickness via shell
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet the vertical (extrusion) edges

    (profile_length,       top_height),

]

with BuildPart() as p:

    with BuildSketch() as outer_sk:
        with BuildLine() as outer_line:
            l1 = Line((0.0, 0.0), (profile_length, 0.0))                     # bottom
            s1 = Spline((profile_length, 0.0), *spline_pts)                  # tall curved wall
            l2 = Line(s1 @ 1, (step_x, step_height))                        # top of step
            s2 = Spline((step_x, step_height), (step_x - 4.0, step_height + 4.0),
                        (step_x - 8.0, top_height - 2.0))                   # curved shoulder
            l3 = Line(s2 @ 1, (0.0, top_height))                            # top edge
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0.0, 0.0))                                   # left end wall
        make_face()

    with BuildSketch() as inner_sk:
        with BuildLine() as inner_line:
            l1 = Line((wall_thickness, wall_thickness),
                      (profile_length - wall_thickness, wall_thickness))     # inner bottom
            s1 = Spline((profile_length - wall_thickness, wall_thickness),
                        (profile_length - 8.0, top_height - 6.0),

            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (wall_thickness, wall_thickness))              # inner left wall
        make_face()

    extrude(inner_sk.sketch, amount=channel_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- overall envelope ---
overall_length = 80.0          # straight length of the curved web
overall_height = 60.0          # overall height of the channel section
overall_width = 30.0           # overall width of the channel section

# --- curved web ---
web_thickness = 2.0            # constant thickness of the curved web
web_radius = 10.0              # radius of the web's curved centreline

# --- flanges ---
flange_thickness = 2.0         # constant thickness of both flanges
flange_width = 12.0            # width of each flange (along the web)
flange_height = 10.0           # height of each flange (across the web)

# --- through hole ---
hole_diameter = 4.0            # diameter of the through hole
hole_offset = 15.0             # hole centre offset from the web centreline

# --- chamfers ---
chamfer_size = 0.5             # chamfer on the flange outer edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# web centreline arc: chord = overall_length, radius = web_radius
web_chord = overall_length
web_half_chord = web_chord / 2.0
web_sagitta = web_radius - (web_radius**2 - web_half_chord**2) ** 0.5

# flange centre planes (offsets from the web centreline)
flange_center_offset = web_radius + flange_thickness / 2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- curved web: sweep a rectangular profile along a circular arc ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as web_profile:
        Rectangle(web_thickness, overall_height)
    with BuildLine() as web_path:
        ThreePointArc((0, 0), (0, web_sagitta), (web_chord, 0))
    sweep(sections=web_profile.sketch, path=web_path.wire())

    # ---- top flange: sweep a rectangular profile along the same arc ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as top_flange_profile:
        Rectangle(flange_width, flange_height)
    with BuildLine() as top_flange_path:
        ThreePointArc((0, flange_center_offset),
                      (0, flange_center_offset + web_sagitta),
                      (web_chord, flange_center_offset))
    sweep(sections=top_flange_profile.sketch, path=top_flange_path.wire())

    # ---- bottom flange: sweep a rectangular profile along the same arc ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as bottom_flange_profile:
        Rectangle(flange_width, flange_height)
    with BuildLine() as bottom_flange_path:
        ThreePointArc((0, -flange_center_offset),
                      (0, -flange_center_offset - web_sagitta),
                      (web_chord, -flange_center_offset))
    sweep(sections=bottom_flange_profile.sketch, path=bottom_flange_path.wire())

    # ---- through hole: cut a cylinder through the web ----
    with Locations((hole_offset, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, overall_height + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer the flange outer edges ----
    # (edges running along the web length, on the outer faces of the flanges)
    outer_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges().filter_by(Axis.X)
        if abs(e.center().Y) > flange_center_offset - 0.1
    ]
    chamfer(outer_edges, chamfer_size)

def hypocycloid(t, r1, r2):
    return (
        (r1 - r2) * math.cos(t) + r2 * math.cos(r1 / r2 * t - t),
        (r1 - r2) * math.sin(t) + r2 * math.sin(-(r1 / r2 * t - t))
    )

def epicycloid(t, r1, r2):
    return (
        (r1 + r2) * math.cos(t) - r2 * math.cos(r1 / r2 * t + t),
        (r1 + r2) * math.sin(t) - r2 * math.sin(r1 / r2 * t + t)
    )

def gear_point(t, r1, r2):
    if (-1) ** (1 + math.floor(t / (2 * math.pi) * (r1 / r2))) < 0:
        return epicycloid(t, r1, r2)
    else:
        return hypocycloid(t, r1, r2)

star_pts_half = star_pts // 2

star_coords = []
for i in range(star_pts):
    angle = math.pi * i / star_pts_half
    r = star_outer_r if i % 2 == 0 else star_inner_r
    star_coords.append((r * math.cos(angle), r * math.sin(angle)))


def hex_vertex_coords(radius):
    """Flat-top regular hexagon vertices (points at 0, 60, ... degrees)."""
    return [(radius * math.cos(math.radians(a)),
             radius * math.sin(math.radians(a)))
            for a in range(0, 360, 60)]


with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- star-shaped cap body ----
    with BuildSketch() as s1:
        Polygon(*star_coords)
    # slightly larger, rounded star rim on top
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(cap_height)) as s2:
        Polygon(*star_coords)
    loft()
    star_body = p.part
    star_body = fillet(star_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), star_edge_fillet)

    # ---- hexagonal socket (flat-top hexagon) ----
    with BuildPart() as hex_p:
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(cap_height)) as s3:
            Polygon(*hex_vertex_coords(hex_radius))
        extrude(amount=-hex_depth)
    hex_socket = hex_p.part

    # ---- central through hole ----
    central_hole = Pos(0, 0, (cap_height - hex_depth) / 2) * Cylinder(
        (central_hole_dia + clearance) / 2, cap_height - hex_depth + 2)

    # ---- combine ----
    part = star_body - hex_socket - central_hole
    part = fillet(part.edges().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1:], rim_fillet)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- overall envelope ---
overall_width = 120.0          # overall width across the two side walls

overall_depth = 30.0           # overall depth of the part

# --- curved side walls ---
wall_thickness = 5.0           # thickness of the curved side walls
wall_radius = 40.0             # radius of the curved side walls

# --- central web ---
web_thickness = 4.0            # thickness of the central web
web_height = 60.0              # height of the central web
web_offset = 10.0              # web offset from the bottom edge

# --- mounting holes ---
hole_diameter = 5.0            # mounting hole diameter
hole_spacing = 30.0            # mounting hole spacing
hole_count = 2                 # mounting holes per side wall

# --- edge breaks ---
chamfer_size = 1.0             # chamfer on the vertical edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived dimensions
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# X position of the web's outer face (web sits against the left wall)
web_outer_x = -overall_width / 2 + wall_thickness + web_thickness

# X positions of the two side walls (inner faces)
left_wall_x = -overall_width / 2 + wall_thickness
right_wall_x = overall_width / 2 - wall_thickness

# Y positions of the mounting holes (centred on the wall height)
hole_ys = [
    overall_height / 2 - (hole_spacing * (hole_count - 1) / 2) + i * hole_spacing
    for i in range(hole_count)
]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- curved side walls (cylindrical surfaces) ----
    # Left wall: cylinder centred at the left inner face, keeping the
    # material on the outer (negative-X) side.
    left_wall = Pos(left_wall_x, 0, overall_height / 2) * Cylinder(
        wall_radius, overall_height
    )
    left_wall = left_wall & Pos(-overall_width / 4, 0, overall_height / 2) * Box(
        overall_width / 2, overall_depth, overall_height
    )

    # Right wall: cylinder centred at the right inner face, keeping the
    # material on the outer (positive-X) side.
    right_wall = Pos(right_wall_x, 0, overall_height / 2) * Cylinder(
        wall_radius, overall_height
    )
    right_wall = right_wall & Pos(overall_width / 4, 0, overall_height / 2) * Box(
        overall_width / 2, overall_depth, overall_height
    )

    # ---- central web (flat plate) ----
    web = Pos(web_outer_x - web_thickness / 2, 0, web_offset + web_height / 2) * Box(
        web_thickness, overall_depth, web_height
    )

    # ---- union all solids ----
    part = left_wall + right_wall + web

    # ---- mounting holes through the side walls ----
    for y in hole_ys:
        # Left wall holes (through the wall thickness in X)
        part = part - Pos(left_wall_x - wall_thickness / 2, 0, y) * Rot(
            0, 90, 0
        ) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, wall_thickness)
        # Right wall holes
        part = part - Pos(right_wall_x + wall_thickness / 2, 0, y) * Rot(
            0, 90, 0
        ) * Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, wall_thickness)

    # ---- chamfer the vertical edges ----
    part = chamfer(part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), chamfer_size)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as outer_sk:
        with Locations((outer_radius, 0)):
            Circle(shell_height / 2.0)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as inner_sk:
        with Locations((outer_radius - wall_thickness, 0)):
            Circle(shell_height / 2.0)
    revolve(sections=[outer_sk.sketch, inner_sk.sketch], revolution_arc=arc_angle_deg)

    # ---- 2. flat end plate closing the shell ----
    # rectangular plate flush with the inner wall face, extending radially
    # inboard by flat_face_depth; its outer edge lies at
    # outer_radius - wall_thickness - flat_face_depth.
    with Locations(
        (
            outer_radius - wall_thickness - flat_face_depth / 2.0,
            0.0,
            shell_height / 2.0,
        )
    ):
        Box(flat_face_width, flat_face_depth, flat_face_height)

    # ---- 3. two mounting holes through the flat plate ----
    # drilled from the outer (flat) face of the plate, through the plate
    # and just into the curved wall.
    for x_pos in (-mount_hole_spacing / 2.0, mount_hole_spacing / 2.0):
        with Locations(
            (
                outer_radius - wall_thickness - flat_face_depth + x_pos,
                mount_hole_offset,
                shell_height / 2.0,
            )
        ):
            Cylinder(
                mount_hole_dia / 2.0,
                flat_face_depth + 2.0,
                align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
                mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
            )

    # ---- 4. small vent hole through the curved wall ----
    # radial through-hole at mid-wall radius, offset along the height.
    with Locations((mid_radius, vent_hole_offset, shell_height / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(
            vent_hole_dia / 2.0,
            wall_thickness + 2.0,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER),
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
        )

    # ---- 5. chamfer all exposed edges ----
    # the curved outer and inner edges, the flat-face perimeter, and the
    # hole rims are all chamfered uniformly.
    chamfer(p.part.edges(), chamfer_size)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# Square inlet block
inlet_width = 40.0          # square section width / height
inlet_depth = 20.0          # block depth along flow (Y)

# Tapered transition (square -> round)
taper_length = 55.0         # length of the lofted transition

# Round outlet
outlet_diameter = 22.0
outlet_length = 15.0        # straight round spigot after the taper

# Blend between taper and spigot
fillet_radius = 2.5

# Internal helical groove (shallow)
groove_radius = outlet_diameter / 2.0 - 2.0
groove_pitch = 12.0
groove_turns = 3
groove_depth = 0.8

# Chamfer on the square inlet end edges
chamfer_distance = 1.6

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # 1. Square inlet block (XZ square, extruded along +Y)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as s:
        Rectangle(inlet_width, inlet_width)
    extrude(amount=inlet_depth)

    # 2. Lofted taper: square inlet section -> round outlet section
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(inlet_depth)) as s1:
        Rectangle(inlet_width, inlet_width)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(inlet_depth + taper_length)) as s2:
        Circle(outlet_diameter / 2.0)
    loft()

    # 3. Straight round spigot at the outlet end
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(inlet_depth + taper_length)) as s3:
        Circle(outlet_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=outlet_length)

solid_body = p.part

# 4. Fillet the circular junction where taper meets spigot
junction_edges = [
    e for e in solid_body.edges()
    if abs(e.center().Y - (inlet_depth + taper_length)) < 0.5
]
solid_body = fillet(junction_edges, fillet_radius)

# 5. Chamfer all edges of the square inlet end (Y = 0 face)
inlet_edges = [
    e for e in solid_body.edges() if abs(e.center().Y) < 0.5
]
solid_body = chamfer(inlet_edges, chamfer_distance)

# 6. Internal helical groove (twisted rectangular section, shallow)
with BuildPart() as gp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as gs:
        with BuildLine() as gl:
            Polyline((groove_radius, -groove_depth / 2.0),
                     (groove_radius + groove_depth, -groove_depth / 2.0),
                     (groove_radius + groove_depth, groove_depth / 2.0),
                     (groove_radius, groove_depth / 2.0),
                     close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(
        amount=taper_length,
        taper=360.0 * groove_turns,
    )

# Cut groove from interior of the transition
solid_body = solid_body - groove_solid

hook_radius = 4.0            # radius of the rounded hook end
hook_center_x = -shank_length / 2.0 + hook_radius   # = -31.0

# --- straight end (right) ---
straight_end_x = shank_length / 2.0                  # = 35.0

tongue_length = 12.0         # tongue length (X)

tongue_root_x = straight_end_x - 0.5                 # slight overlap into shank
tongue_tip_x = tongue_root_x + tongue_length         # = 46.5

eyelet_diameter = 4.0

eyelet_center_y = 0.0

# --- tongue tip hole (through the tongue) ---
tip_hole_diameter = 2.8
tip_hole_clearance = 0.1
tip_hole_center_x = tongue_tip_x - 0.5               # = 46.0

# --- relief slot at the tongue root ---
relief_width = 2.0

relief_center_x = tongue_root_x + 1.0

# --- fillets / chamfers ---
tongue_root_fillet = 1.4    # fillet where the tongue meets the shank
tip_chamfer = 0.4           # chamfer on the tongue tip edges
eyelet_chamfer = 0.3        # chamfer on the eyelet hole edges

    # ---- main body: straight shank + rounded hook end ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as sk:
        Rectangle(shank_width, shank_thickness)
    with BuildLine() as bl:
        # straight shank
        Line((hook_center_x, 0.0), (straight_end_x, 0.0))

        ThreePointArc((hook_center_x, 0.0),
                      (hook_center_x - hook_radius, 0.0),
                      (hook_center_x, -shank_width))
        # close the profile
        Line((hook_center_x, -shank_width), (hook_center_x, 0.0))

    with Locations((tongue_root_x, 0.0, 0.0)):

    tip_edges = [e for e in p.edges()

    with Locations((eyelet_center_x, eyelet_center_y, 0.0)):

                 tongue_thickness + 2.0,

    with Locations((relief_center_x, 0.0, 0.0)):

            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

                    if abs(e.center().X - eyelet_center_x) < 0.5

def make_knuckle(length, radius, fillet_r, hole_dia):
    """Cylinder along X with filleted ends and a through hole on its axis."""
    cyl = Pos(0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(radius, length)
    cyl = fillet(cyl.edges(), fillet_r)
    cyl = cyl - Pos(0, 0, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_dia / 2, length + 2)
    return cyl

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - taken from the part drawing
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
strap_width    = 31.0     # constant width of the strap
strap_thick    = 7.7      # constant thickness of the strap

# Vertical stem: from the bottom end up to the fork start
stem_height    = 48.0

# Upper fork: two straight prongs
prong_len      = 40.0     # straight length of each prong
prong_taper    = 10.0     # end taper of each prong

# Fillet at the fork junction and at the free ends of the prongs
prong_fillet   = 5.5

# Two identical through holes in the stem (centred on the strap width)
hole_radius    = 12.2
hole1_y        = 15.5     # lower hole centre
hole2_y        = 48.6     # upper hole centre

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the outline as a single closed polygon (no arcs - the prong ends are
# rounded with a fillet applied after the profile is cut)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch() as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (0, 0), (strap_width, 0),                          # bottom end
                (strap_width, stem_height),                        # fork start
                (strap_width + prong_len, stem_height + prong_len),# right prong tip
                (strap_width + prong_taper, stem_height + prong_len + prong_taper),
                (0, stem_height + prong_taper),                    # left prong tip
                close=True
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=strap_thick)

solid_body = p.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Round the two free prong ends and the fork junction with a single fillet
# (all vertical edges of the profile)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z), prong_fillet)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Cut the two identical through holes in the stem
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
for y in (hole1_y, hole2_y):
    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(strap_width / 2, y, 0) * Cylinder(hole_radius, strap_thick * 2)

part = solid_body
export_step(part, "output.step")

import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm) - all from the drawing unless noted
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
base_size = 80.0            # square base footprint (overall 80 x 80)
base_thickness = 15.0       # base flange thickness
corner_chamfer = 5.0        # C5 chamfer on the four vertical base corners

body_height = 60.0          # cylindrical body height above the base
body_od = 52.5              # cylindrical body outside diameter
body_wall = 5.0             # body wall thickness
body_id = body_od - 2.0 * body_wall     # 42.5, internal cavity

seat_diameter = 30.0        # bearing-seat bore diameter
seat_depth = 10.0           # bearing-seat recess depth from the base top
seat_clearance = 0.5        # clearance of the seat bore over the bearing

bolt_hole_diameter = 8.0    # M8 through holes
bolt_head_diameter = 13.0   # M8 hex head across flats
bolt_head_height = 4.0
bolt_head_chamfer = 0.8
bolt_head_angle = 90.0
bolt_hole_depth = base_thickness + body_height + 1.0
bolt_radius = 25.0          # bolt circle radius (four holes, 90 deg apart)

fillet_radius = 1.2         # C1.2 fillet on all base edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
seat_radius = seat_diameter / 2.0
seat_bore_radius = seat_radius + seat_clearance
bolt_head_radius = bolt_head_diameter / 2.0
bolt_head_sink_r = bolt_head_radius + bolt_head_height * math.tan(
    math.radians(bolt_head_angle / 2.0))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- square base flange -----------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Rectangle(base_size, base_size)
    extrude(amount=base_thickness)

    # chamfer the four vertical outer corners of the base
    base_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    chamfer(base_edges, corner_chamfer)

    # fillet all remaining base edges (top and bottom perimeters)
    base_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z, reverse=True)
    fillet(base_edges, fillet_radius)

    # --- cylindrical body on top of the base ------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, base_thickness)):
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            Circle(body_od / 2.0)
        extrude(amount=body_height)

    # --- internal cavity, open at the base face ---------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, -1.0)):
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            Circle(body_id / 2.0)
        extrude(amount=base_thickness + body_height + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- bearing seat recess ----------------------------------------
    with Locations((0, 0, base_thickness - seat_depth - 1.0)):
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
            Circle(seat_bore_radius)
        extrude(amount=seat_depth + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- four counterbored mounting holes on a square bolt pattern ---
    bolt_positions = [
        (bolt_radius, bolt_radius),
        (-bolt_radius, bolt_radius),
        (-bolt_radius, -bolt_radius),
        (bolt_radius, -bolt_radius),
    ]
    for x, y in bolt_positions:
        # straight through hole
        with Locations((x, y, -1.0)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
                Circle(bolt_hole_diameter / 2.0)
            extrude(amount=bolt_hole_depth + 2.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

        # countersink seat for the bolt head (flat head / hex socket)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

thread_turns     = thread_len / thread_pitch

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

chamfer_boss     = 2.5      # boss top rim (outer + inner)

chamfer_insert   = 0.8      # threaded insert entry/exit

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
bore_r           = through_dia / 2.0
boss_r           = boss_outer_dia / 2.0
clear_r          = clearance_hole_d / 2.0
thread_root_r    = bore_r + thread_clear
thread_crest_r   = thread_root_r + thread_depth
helix_radius     = thread_root_r + 0.5 * thread_depth
thread_top_z     = base_thick + boss_height - thread_len

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(base_thick)) as s_boss:

    extrude(amount=boss_height)

    # ---- central through bore ------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as s_bore:
        Circle(bore_r)
    extrude(amount=base_thick + boss_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- four clearance holes (top and bottom of base) -----------
    for x, y in [(hole_offset, hole_offset), (-hole_offset, hole_offset),

            mode=Mode.ADD)

import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- central hub -------------------------------------------------
hub_outer_dia = 40.0          # hub outside diameter
hub_inner_dia = 30.5          # hub through bore
hub_length    = 30.0          # hub axial length

# --- six identical hollow spokes ---------------------------------
spoke_outer_dia = 28.0        # spoke outside diameter
spoke_inner_dia = 18.1        # spoke through bore
spoke_length    = 30.0        # spoke axial length

# --- spoke layout -------------------------------------------------
spoke_center_radius = 30.0    # radial distance of spoke centres
spoke_overlap     = 0.5       # how far each spoke root sinks into the hub

# --- small radial set-screw holes --------------------------------
set_screw_dia = 3.0           # set-screw hole diameter
set_screw_depth = 12.0        # blind hole depth (radial)
set_screw_z     = 15.0        # hole axis height (mid length)

# --- fillets / chamfers ------------------------------------------
root_fillet_radius = 2.0      # fillet where spoke roots meet the hub
tip_chamfer         = 1.0     # chamfer on the spoke outer rim

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
hub_outer_r = hub_outer_dia / 2.0
hub_inner_r = hub_inner_dia / 2.0
spoke_outer_r = spoke_outer_dia / 2.0
spoke_inner_r = spoke_inner_dia / 2.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- central hub (hollow cylinder) --------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as hub_sk:
        with BuildLine() as hub_line:
            l1 = Line((hub_inner_r, 0), (hub_outer_r, 0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (hub_outer_r, hub_length))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (hub_inner_r, hub_length))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (hub_inner_r, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ---- six hollow spokes --------------------------------------
    for i in range(6):
        angle = math.radians(i * 60.0)
        cx = (spoke_center_radius - spoke_overlap) * math.cos(angle)
        cy = (spoke_center_radius - spoke_overlap) * math.sin(angle)

        with Locations((cx, cy, 0)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sp_sk:
                with BuildLine() as sp_line:
                    s1 = Line((spoke_inner_r, 0), (spoke_outer_r, 0))
                    s2 = Line(s1 @ 1, (spoke_outer_r, spoke_length))
                    s3 = Line(s2 @ 1, (spoke_inner_r, spoke_length))
                    s4 = Line(s3 @ 1, (spoke_inner_r, 0))
                make_face()
            revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ---- small radial set-screw holes (blind) -------------------
    for i in range(6):
        angle = math.radians(i * 60.0)
        cx = (spoke_center_radius - spoke_overlap) * math.cos(angle)
        cy = (spoke_center_radius - spoke_overlap) * math.sin(angle)

        with Locations((cx, cy, set_screw_z)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as ss_sk:
                with BuildLine() as ss_line:
                    h1 = Line((spoke_inner_r, 0), (spoke_inner_r + set_screw_depth, 0))
                    h2 = Line(h1 @ 1, (spoke_inner_r + set_screw_depth, set_screw_dia))
                    h3 = Line(h2 @ 1, (spoke_inner_r, set_screw_dia))
                    h4 = Line(h3 @ 1, (spoke_inner_r, 0))
                make_face()
            revolve(axis=Axis.Z, revolution_arc=360.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- fillet the spoke roots where they meet the hub ---------
    root_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z) < 1e-6
        and (hub_outer_r - 0.5) < e.radius < (spoke_outer_r + 0.5)
    ]
    fillet(root_edges, radius=root_fillet_radius)

    # ---- chamfer the outer rim of every spoke -------------------
    tip_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z - spoke_length) < 1e-6
        and (spoke_outer_r - 0.5) < e.radius < (spoke_outer_r + 0.5)
    ]
    chamfer(tip_edges, length=tip_chamfer)

export_step(part, "output.step")

spoke_radial_len = spoke_outer_r - spoke_inner_r   # = 7.0

spoke_center_r  = hub_radius + spoke_radial_len / 2.0
spoke_overlap   = 2.0      # ring overlaps the hub by this amount

# drilled hole through the ring
spoke_hole_r    = 5.0
spoke_hole_offset = spoke_center_r + 2.0

# small fillet where the spoke ring meets the hub
fillet_radius   = 0.5

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as hs:

            Circle(hub_radius)

    hub = offset(hub, amount=-wall_thickness)

    # ---- one spoke: annular ring + drilled hole ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as ss:
        with Locations((spoke_center_r, 0.0)):
            Circle(spoke_outer_r)
            Circle(spoke_inner_r, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

arm_base_radius = 19.0          # arm cross-section radius at base
arm_tip_radius = 12.5           # arm cross-section radius at tip

wall_thickness = 2.1            # thin shell wall

pocket_diameter = 18.0          # blind pocket diameter in each arm
pocket_depth = 6.0              # blind pocket depth

chamfer_size = 1.3              # chamfer on outer rim of each arm tip

# ---- derived layout ----
arm_center_radius = bore_radius + arm_length * 0.45
arm_tip_radius_center = bore_radius + arm_length


def arm_solid(theta_deg: float) -> PosRot:
    """Build one radial arm as a solid cone (base at bore, tapering to tip)."""
    cone = Cone(arm_base_radius, arm_tip_radius, arm_length)
    cone = Pos(0, 0, arm_length / 2) * cone
    cone = Rot(0, 0, theta_deg) * cone
    cone = Pos(0, 0, -bore_radius) * cone
    return cone

    # central hub (short cylinder spanning the bore)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with Locations((bore_radius, 0)):
            Circle(bore_radius)
    extrude(amount=bore_radius * 2)

    # six radial arms (conical, equally spaced)
    for i in range(6):
        arm_solid(i * 60)

    # central through bore
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(bore_radius)
    extrude(amount=bore_radius * 2, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # blind pocket in each arm tip
    for i in range(6):
        a = math.radians(i * 60)
        px = arm_center_radius * math.cos(a)
        py = arm_center_radius * math.sin(a)
        with Locations((px, py, bore_radius - pocket_depth / 2)):
            Cylinder(pocket_diameter / 2, pocket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

             if abs(e.center().Z - arm_tip_radius_center) < 1e-3]

collar_length = 15.0       # overall collar length along the axis

# --- central through bore ---
bore_radius = 12.0

# --- radial set-screw slot ---
set_screw_diameter = 4.0
set_screw_depth = 8.0

# --- hexagonal socket for the set screw ---
hex_flat_across = 8.0
hex_depth = 6.0

slot_depth = 2.0

relief_groove_width = 2.0
relief_groove_depth = 1.5

# --- chamfers (mm) ---
chamfer_bore = 0.5
chamfer_slot = 0.5

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- collar body: revolve rectangular cross-section about the axis ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (inner_radius, 0),
                (outer_radius, 0),
                (outer_radius, collar_length),
                (inner_radius, collar_length),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # --- central through bore ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        Circle(bore_radius)
    extrude(amount=collar_length + 2, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- radial set-screw slot ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with Locations((inner_radius, collar_length / 2)):
            Circle(set_screw_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=set_screw_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- hexagonal socket for the set screw ---
    hex_radius = hex_flat_across / (2 * math.cos(math.radians(30)))
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with Locations((inner_radius, collar_length / 2)):
            RegularPolygon(hex_radius, 6)
    extrude(amount=hex_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- three lightening through slots ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with Locations(
            (outer_radius - slot_depth / 2, collar_length / 3),
            (outer_radius - slot_depth / 2, 2 * collar_length / 3),
            (outer_radius - slot_depth / 2, collar_length),
        ):
            Rectangle(slot_width, collar_length + 2)
    extrude(amount=collar_length + 2, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

inner_radius = 0.5 * inner_diameter

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
inner = Pos(0, 0, (outer_height - wall) / 2) * Box(
    outer_width - 2 * wall, outer_depth - 2 * wall, outer_height - wall
)
shell = outer - inner

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Central through-cavity
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
cavity = Pos(0, 0, cavity_height / 2) * Box(cavity_width, outer_depth, cavity_height)
shell = shell - cavity

    zc = wall + rib_height / 2 + i * rib_spacing

        -(cavity_width / 2 + rib_depth / 2), 0, zc
    ) * Box(rib_depth, outer_depth - 2 * wall, rib_height)
    # right wall rib

        (cavity_width / 2 + rib_depth / 2), 0, zc
    ) * Box(rib_depth, outer_depth - 2 * wall, rib_height)

    outer_width, outer_depth, lid_thickness
)

    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Bore drilled through the full length of the channel
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    bore_center_y = wall_thickness + interior_clearance
    with Locations((0.0, bore_center_y, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(
            bore_diameter / 2.0,
            channel_length,
            align=(Align.CENTER, Align.CENTER, Align.MIN),
            mode=Mode.SUBTRACT,
        )

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    # Small fillet where the bore meets the top wall (junction)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    junction_edges = [
        e
        for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().Z - channel_height) < 1e-3
        and abs(e.center().Y - bore_center_y) < 1.0
    ]
    fillet(junction_edges, fillet_radius)

part = p.part
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# U-channel (half-round) trough - full parametric model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
outer_radius = 40.0          # outer half-round radius (mm)
wall_thickness = 5.0         # constant wall thickness
inner_radius = outer_radius - wall_thickness   # 35.0
channel_length = 80.0        # straight length of the trough
fillet_radius = 4.0          # internal corner fillet radius
boss_radius = 12.0           # circular boss radius
boss_height = 8.0            # boss height (sits flush with the floor)
hole_diameter = 5.0          # drain hole diameter
hole_spacing = 30.0          # drain hole spacing along the floor
num_holes = 3                # number of drain holes

with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- outer half-round profile (XZ plane, cut away Z>0) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as outer_sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, -2 * outer_radius))
            Line((outer_radius, -2 * outer_radius), (-outer_radius, -2 * outer_radius))
            Line((-outer_radius, -2 * outer_radius), (-outer_radius, 0))
            Line((-outer_radius, 0), (outer_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=channel_length)

    # ---- inner half-round profile (XZ plane, cut away Z>0) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as inner_sk:
        with BuildLine():
            Line((inner_radius, 0), (inner_radius, -2 * inner_radius))
            Line((inner_radius, -2 * inner_radius), (-inner_radius, -2 * inner_radius))
            Line((-inner_radius, -2 * inner_radius), (-inner_radius, 0))
            Line((-inner_radius, 0), (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=channel_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- circular boss on the floor (Z = -2R + wall) ----
    with Locations((0, channel_length / 2, -2 * outer_radius + wall_thickness)):
        Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)

    # ---- evenly spaced drain holes through the floor ----
    for i in range(num_holes):
        x = (i - (num_holes - 1) / 2) * hole_spacing
        with Locations((x, 0, -2 * outer_radius + wall_thickness / 2)):
            Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2, wall_thickness, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- fillet the internal corner edges (inner wall / floor) ----
    # inner wall surface sits at X = +35 and X = -35; floor at Z = -70
    inner_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if abs(e.center().X - inner_radius) < 1e-3
        or abs(e.center().X + inner_radius) < 1e-3
        or abs(e.center().Z + 2 * outer_radius) < 1e-3
    ]
    fillet(inner_edges, fillet_radius)

# --- revolved profile (radius, axial position) ---
inlet_radius   = 12.0        # inlet flange outer radius
inlet_face_y   = 0.0         # inlet end face
shoulder_y     = 2.0         # start of the short inlet shoulder
throat_radius  = 6.0         # minimum (throat) radius
throat_y       = 30.0        # axial position of the throat
body_radius    = 14.0        # main body radius
body_start_y   = 40.0        # start of the straight body section
body_end_y     = 60.0        # end of the straight body section
outlet_radius  = 18.0        # outlet flange outer radius
outlet_face_y  = total_length

# --- inlet port ---
inlet_hole_dia = 8.0
inlet_hole_depth = 10.0

# --- outlet port ---
outlet_hole_dia = 10.0
outlet_hole_depth = 12.0

# --- mounting holes (through the flanges) ---
mount_hole_dia = 4.0
mount_hole_radius = 15.0     # radial position of the mounting holes

# --- edge breaks ---
chamfer_size = 1.0           # chamfer on the inlet / outlet end faces

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- revolved solid body -------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0.0, inlet_face_y), (inlet_radius, inlet_face_y))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (inlet_radius, shoulder_y))
            a1 = ThreePointArc(l2 @ 1, (throat_radius, throat_y),
                               (body_radius, body_start_y))
            l3 = Line(a1 @ 1, (body_radius, body_end_y))
            a2 = ThreePointArc(l3 @ 1, (outlet_radius, outlet_face_y - 5.0),
                               (outlet_radius, outlet_face_y))
            l4 = Line(a2 @ 1, (0.0, outlet_face_y))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (0.0, inlet_face_y))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    # ---- inlet port (blind hole from the inlet face) -------------
    with Locations((0.0, inlet_face_y + inlet_hole_depth / 2.0, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(inlet_hole_dia / 2.0, inlet_hole_depth,
                 rotation=(90.0, 0.0, 0.0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- outlet port (blind hole from the outlet face) -----------
    with Locations((0.0, outlet_face_y - outlet_hole_depth / 2.0, 0.0)):
        Cylinder(outlet_hole_dia / 2.0, outlet_hole_depth,
                 rotation=(90.0, 0.0, 0.0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    inlet_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[0]
    outlet_face = p.part.faces().sort_by(Axis.Y)[-1]

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

# Central plate

plate_depth = 32.0        # overall width  (2 x R)
plate_radius = 16.0       # end radius (half the width)
plate_thickness = 8.0

# Two identical cylindrical bosses, mirrored about the plate centre
boss_radius = 8.0
boss_height = 24.0
boss_offset = 30.0        # boss centre distance from the plate centre

# Milled pocket on the top face of the plate
pocket_length = 48.0
pocket_width = 20.0
pocket_depth = 4.0
pocket_corner_radius = 3.0

# Four through holes, symmetric about the plate centre
hole_radius = 2.5
hole_pitch_x = 40.0
hole_pitch_y = 20.0

# Chamfer on all vertical edges (plate rim + boss rims)
edge_chamfer = 1.0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- flat plate with two semicircular ends ---
    with BuildSketch() as plate_sk:
        with Locations((-plate_width/2 + plate_radius, 0)):
            Circle(plate_radius)
        with Locations((plate_width/2 - plate_radius, 0)):
            Circle(plate_radius)
        Rectangle(plate_width - 2*plate_radius, plate_depth)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- two mirrored cylindrical bosses ---
    with Locations((-boss_offset, 0), (boss_offset, 0)):
        Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)

    # --- milled pocket in the top face of the plate ---
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(plate_thickness)) as pocket_sk:
        RectangleRounded(pocket_length, pocket_width, pocket_corner_radius)
    extrude(amount=-pocket_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- four through holes ---
    with Locations((-hole_pitch_x/2, -hole_pitch_y/2),
                   ( hole_pitch_x/2, -hole_pitch_y/2),
                   (-hole_pitch_x/2,  hole_pitch_y/2),
                   ( hole_pitch_x/2,  hole_pitch_y/2)):
        Cylinder(hole_radius, 100.0, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # --- chamfer every vertical edge ---
    vertical_edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    chamfer(vertical_edges, edge_chamfer)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_radius    = 40.0     # finished outer cylindrical surface radius
inner_radius    = 20.0     # finished bore radius (threaded insert bore)
collar_width    = 32.0     # finished axial width (shoulder face to shoulder face)
fillet_radius   = 5.0      # small uniform fillet on all finished edges

# Turned groove profile
groove_center_z = 16.0     # groove centre on the mid-plane of the collar
groove_start_z  = 12.0     # flat bottom of the groove
groove_end_z    = 20.0     # flat top of the groove
groove_depth    = 4.0      # radial depth of the groove (40 -> 36)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Revolve the profile about the central axis
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((0, 0), (outer_radius, 0))                 # lower shoulder face
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (outer_radius, collar_width))      # outer cylindrical surface
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0, collar_width))                 # upper shoulder face
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (0, 0))                            # close the profile
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bore: straight hole through the full collar width
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Pos(0, 0, collar_width / 2) * Cylinder(inner_radius, collar_width)

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Turned groove: revolved cut on the outer cylindrical surface
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as gp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as gsk:
        with BuildLine() as gbl:
            gl1 = Line((outer_radius, groove_center_z), (outer_radius - groove_depth, groove_center_z))
            gl2 = Line(gl1 @ 1, (outer_radius - groove_depth, groove_start_z))
            ga1 = ThreePointArc(gl2 @ 1, (outer_radius - groove_depth / 2, (groove_start_z + groove_end_z) / 2),
                                (outer_radius, groove_end_z))
            gl3 = Line(ga1 @ 1, (outer_radius, groove_center_z))  # close the profile
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

solid_body = solid_body - gp.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fillet all finished edges
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
solid_body = fillet(solid_body.edges(), fillet_radius)

part = solid_body
part.name = "collar_with_groove"
export_step(part, "output.step")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameters (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
length          = 80.0    # extrusion length of the channel
web_height      = 40.0    # full height of the Z-section
web_thickness   = 6.0     # vertical web thickness
flange_width    = 30.0    # horizontal flange width
flange_thickness = 6.0    # top / bottom flange thickness
taper_length    = 12.0    # length of the inclined web run
hole_diameter   = 5.0     # tapped hole diameter
hole_depth      = 10.0    # blind hole depth
hole_spacing    = 25.0    # pitch between the two holes
hole_offset     = 15.0    # hole position from the section centreline
chamfer_size    = 1.0     # chamfer on the two long flange edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Z-section profile (half-profile, mirrored about the X axis)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Upper half: bottom flange -> inclined web -> top flange
half_profile = [
    (0.0, -web_height / 2.0),
    (web_thickness, -web_height / 2.0),
    (web_thickness, -web_height / 2.0 + flange_thickness),
    (flange_width - taper_length, web_height / 2.0 - flange_thickness),
    (flange_width, web_height / 2.0 - flange_thickness),
    (flange_width, web_height / 2.0),
    (0.0, web_height / 2.0),
]
# Lower half: mirror of the upper half about the X axis
mirrored = [(x, -z) for (x, z) in reversed(half_profile)]
full_profile = half_profile + mirrored

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the solid
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Extrude the closed Z-profile along the channel length
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        Polygon(*full_profile)
    extrude(amount=length)

    # Two blind tapped holes on the top flange face
    with Locations((hole_offset, length / 2.0, web_height / 2.0),
                   (hole_offset + hole_spacing, length / 2.0, web_height / 2.0)):
        Cylinder(hole_diameter / 2.0, hole_depth, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Chamfer the two long outer edges of the top flange
    edges = p.part.edges().filter_by(Axis.Y)
    top_edges = [e for e in edges
                 if abs(e.center().Z - web_height / 2.0) < 1e-6
                 and abs(e.center().X) > flange_width - 1e-6]
    chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_size)

    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:

                l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (hub_radius, blade_width))
                l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (hub_radius, 0))
            make_face()
        extrude(amount=blade_thickness, rotation=(0, angle, 0))

    # ---- Central shaft bore --------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        Circle(bore_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=hub_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- Keyway in the bore --------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        Rectangle(keyway_width, keyway_length)
    extrude(amount=-keyway_depth,
            location=Pos(bore_diameter / 2.0, hub_length / 2.0, 0))

    # ---- V-groove around the hub rim -----------------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((hub_radius - groove_depth, hub_length / 2.0 - groove_width / 2.0),

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (hub_radius - groove_depth, hub_length / 2.0 - groove_width / 2.0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Y)

    for i in range(num_mount_holes):
        theta = math.radians(i * 360.0 / num_mount_holes)
        px = mount_hole_radius * math.cos(theta)
        pz = mount_hole_radius * math.sin(theta)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as sk:

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_diameter = 80.0        # impeller outside diameter (tip envelope)
hub_diameter = 50.0          # hub outside diameter
hub_length = 15.0            # hub axial width
blade_count = 4              # number of blades
blade_tip_radius = 40.0      # radial tip of each blade
blade_root_radius = 20.0     # where the blade blends into the hub
blade_width = 20.0           # blade axial width

bore_diameter = 30.0         # central shaft bore
key_width = 4.0              # keyway width
key_depth = 2.0              # keyway radial depth
key_length = hub_length * 0.8

groove_diameter = 42.0       # circumferential V-groove centre diameter
groove_depth = 3.0           # groove depth (radial)

mount_hole_dia = 3.5         # radial mounting holes in the hub
mount_hole_radius = 22.0     # hole centre radius
mount_hole_count = 10        # holes equally spaced around the hub

fillet_radius = 0.85         # blade root fillet

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---------------- hub ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as hs:
        Circle(hub_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=hub_length)

    # ---------------- one blade (root -> tip -> root, closed) ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as bs:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((blade_root_radius, -blade_width / 2.0),
                      (blade_tip_radius, -blade_width / 2.0))
            arc = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1,
                                (blade_tip_radius + 4.0, 0.0),
                                (blade_tip_radius, blade_width / 2.0))
            l2 = Line(arc @ 1, (blade_root_radius, blade_width / 2.0))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, l1 @ 0)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=hub_length)

    # ---------------- remaining blades ----------------
    for i in range(1, blade_count):
        angle = i * 360.0 / blade_count
        # blade profile lies in the XZ plane, so rotate about the Y axis
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.rotated((0, angle, 0))) as bs2:
            with BuildLine() as bl2:
                l1 = Line((blade_root_radius, -blade_width / 2.0),
                          (blade_tip_radius, -blade_width / 2.0))
                arc = ThreePointArc(l1 @ 1,
                                    (blade_tip_radius + 4.0, 0.0),
                                    (blade_tip_radius, blade_width / 2.0))
                l2 = Line(arc @ 1, (blade_root_radius, blade_width / 2.0))
                l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, l1 @ 0)
            make_face()
        extrude(amount=hub_length)

    # ---------------- fillet the blade roots ----------------
    root_edges = [
        e for e in p.edges()
        if 18.0 < math.hypot(e.center().X, e.center().Z) < 23.0
    ]
    fillet(root_edges, fillet_radius)

    # ---------------- central shaft bore ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as bore_sk:
        Circle(bore_diameter / 2.0)
    extrude(amount=hub_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- keyway ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as key_sk:
        with Locations((bore_diameter / 2.0 + key_depth / 2.0, 0.0)):
            Rectangle(key_width, key_length)
    extrude(amount=hub_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- circumferential V-groove ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as vg_sk:
        with BuildLine() as vg_bl:
            l1 = Line((groove_diameter / 2.0 - groove_depth, -groove_depth),
                      (groove_diameter / 2.0, 0.0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1,
                      (groove_diameter / 2.0 - groove_depth, groove_depth))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, l1 @ 0)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=hub_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---------------- radial mounting holes ----------------
    for i in range(mount_hole_count):
        theta = math.radians(i * 360.0 / mount_hole_count)
        px = mount_hole_radius * math.cos(theta)
        pz = mount_hole_radius * math.sin(theta)
        with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as mh_sk:
            with Locations((px, pz)):
                Circle(mount_hole_dia / 2.0)
        extrude(amount=hub_length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

from build123d import *
import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- overall envelope ---
outer_diameter = 80.0          # maximum diameter of the twisted blade ring
inner_diameter = 30.0          # hub / bore diameter
hub_length = 60.0              # axial length of the hub
blade_length = 60.0            # axial length of the blades
total_length = hub_length + blade_length   # 120 mm overall

# --- blade profile ---
blade_root_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0   # 15 mm
blade_tip_radius = outer_diameter / 2.0    # 40 mm
blade_thickness = 6.0                      # radial thickness of a blade
blade_count = 8                            # number of blades
blade_twist_deg = 360.0                    # full twist over the blade length

# --- hub ---
hub_radius = inner_diameter / 2.0          # 15 mm
hub_bore_diameter = 10.0                   # central through bore

# --- mounting holes (on the hub end face) ---
mount_hole_count = 4
mount_hole_radius = hub_radius * 0.5       # 7.5 mm from centre
mount_hole_diameter = 2.0                  # through hole
mount_cbore_diameter = 4.5                 # counterbore diameter
mount_cbore_depth = 3.0                    # counterbore depth

# --- blade root fillet ---
root_fillet_radius = 1.0                   # fillet at blade root junction

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derived values
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
blade_pitch_deg = 360.0 / blade_count      # 45 deg between blades
blade_root_angle = math.radians(blade_pitch_deg * 0.35)   # root chord angle
blade_tip_angle = math.radians(blade_pitch_deg * 0.70)    # tip chord angle

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- hub (straight cylinder) ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as hub_sk:
        Circle(hub_radius)
    extrude(amount=hub_length)

    # ---- twisted blades ----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as blade_sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            # root chord
            Polyline(
                (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2),
                 blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2)),
                (blade_root_radius * math.cos(blade_root_angle / 2),
                 blade_root_radius * math.sin(blade_root_angle / 2)),
            )
            # leading edge (root -> tip)
            ThreePointArc(
                (blade_root_radius * math.cos(blade_root_angle / 2),
                 blade_root_radius * math.sin(blade_root_angle / 2)),
                (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2),
                 blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2)),
                (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15),
                 blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15)),
            )
            # tip chord
            Polyline(
                (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15),
                 blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15)),
                (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15),
                 blade_tip_radius * math.sin(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15)),
            )
            # trailing edge (tip -> root)
            ThreePointArc(
                (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15),
                 blade_tip_radius * math.sin(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15)),
                (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2),
                 blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2)),
                (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2 - 0.10),
                 blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2 - 0.10)),
            )
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=blade_length, taper=blade_twist_deg)

    # ---- repeat the blade around the axis ----
    for i in range(1, blade_count):
        with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as blade_sk_i:
                with BuildLine() as bl_i:
                    Polyline(
                        (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2),
                         blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2)),
                        (blade_root_radius * math.cos(blade_root_angle / 2),
                         blade_root_radius * math.sin(blade_root_angle / 2)),
                    )
                    ThreePointArc(
                        (blade_root_radius * math.cos(blade_root_angle / 2),
                         blade_root_radius * math.sin(blade_root_angle / 2)),
                        (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2),
                         blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2)),
                        (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15),
                         blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15)),
                    )
                    Polyline(
                        (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15),
                         blade_tip_radius * math.sin(blade_tip_angle / 2 + 0.15)),
                        (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15),
                         blade_tip_radius * math.sin(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15)),
                    )
                    ThreePointArc(
                        (blade_tip_radius * math.cos(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15),
                         blade_tip_radius * math.sin(-blade_tip_angle / 2 - 0.15)),
                        (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2),
                         blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2)),
                        (blade_root_radius * math.cos(-blade_root_angle / 2 - 0.10),
                         blade_root_radius * math.sin(-blade_root_angle / 2 - 0.10)),
                    )
                make_face()
            extrude(amount=blade_length, taper=blade_twist_deg,

mid_span          = 40.0      # mid span station (half of blade_span)

    # ---------------- single blade profile ----------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as blade:
        with BuildLine():
            # leading edge : smooth spline with a shallow camber

                (hub_radius, -root_thick / 2),
                (hub_radius + 8.0, -root_thick / 2 - 0.5),
                (hub_radius + 20.0, -camber_height),
                (hub_radius + 30.0, -camber_height * camber_ratio),

            # trailing edge : smooth spline back to the root

                (tip_radius, tip_thick / 2),
                (hub_radius + 30.0, tip_thick / 2 + 0.5),
                (hub_radius + 20.0, mid_thick / 2),
                (hub_radius + 8.0, root_thick / 2 + 0.5),
                (hub_radius, root_thick / 2),
            )
            # root edge

import math

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
outer_radius      = 30.0          # outer radius of the bellows tube
inner_radius      = 24.0          # inner radius (wall thickness = 6.0)
wall_thickness    = outer_radius - inner_radius

length            = 80.0          # overall bellows length
flange_width      = 5.0           # extra radial width of the flange
flange_thickness  = 10.0          # axial thickness of the flange

rib_count         = 6             # number of internal stiffening ribs
rib_width         = 1.6           # rib thickness in the radial direction
rib_depth         = 2.0           # rib thickness in the circumferential direction

corrugation_count = 6             # number of convolutions
corrugation_ampl  = 2.0           # corrugation amplitude (radial)

bore_diameter     = 10.0          # central through bore
chamfer_size      = 0.5           # chamfer on the bore edges

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # ---- main cylindrical tube -------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        Circle(outer_radius)
        Circle(inner_radius)
    extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- flange at the bottom (z = 0 .. flange_thickness) ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sf:
        Circle(outer_radius + flange_width)
    extrude(amount=flange_thickness)

    # ---- internal stiffening ribs ----------------------------------
    rib_r = inner_radius + rib_depth / 2.0
    for i in range(rib_count):
        angle = math.radians(i * 360.0 / rib_count)
        px = rib_r * math.cos(angle)
        py = rib_r * math.sin(angle)
        with Locations((px, py, length / 2)):
            with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as s_rib:
                Rectangle(rib_width, rib_depth)
            extrude(amount=length)

    # ---- corrugated profile (radial sinusoid) ----------------------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ) as s_corr:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            l1 = Line((inner_radius, 0), (inner_radius, length))
            l2 = Line(l1@1, (outer_radius, length))
            l3 = Line(l2@1, (outer_radius, 0))
            l4 = Line(l3@1, (inner_radius, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)

    # ---- central through bore -------------------------------------
    with BuildSketch() as s_bore:
        Circle(bore_diameter / 2)
    extrude(amount=length + 20, both=True, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # ---- chamfer the bore edges -----------------------------------
    bore_edges = [
        e for e in p.part.edges()
        if abs(e.radius - bore_diameter / 2) < 0.5
    ]
    chamfer(bore_edges, chamfer_size)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------

top_arm_center = arm_thickness + gap1 + arm_thickness + gap2 + arm_thickness / 2.0

    """Arm plate, centred at the web face and extending out to the tip."""

        arm_length, arm_thickness, arm_width
    )

    with Locations(Pos(web_thickness / 2.0, web_height / 2.0, 0.0)):

    with Locations((0.0, 0.0, -web_width / 2.0 + web_margin)):

wall_thickness = 1.2     # shell wall thickness

# Side mounting plate

plate_height = 80.0      # along X

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # --- Triangular rib: closed triangular profile in the YZ plane ----------
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ) as rib_sk:
        with BuildLine() as rib_line:
            l1 = Line((0.0, -rib_base / 2.0), (0.0, rib_base / 2.0))
            l2 = Line(l1 @ 1, (rib_height, 0.0))
            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (0.0, -rib_base / 2.0))
        make_face()

    # --- Extrude the rib to a constant thickness along X -------------------
    extrude(amount=rib_thickness)

    # --- Side mounting plate (fused to the rib at the X = 0 interface) -----
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ.offset(rib_thickness / 2.0)) as plate_sk:
        Rectangle(plate_width, plate_height)
    extrude(amount=plate_thickness)

    # --- Generous fillets on the rib edges (before shelling) ---------------
    rib_edges = [e for e in p.part.edges() if e.center().X < rib_thickness - 1e-6]
    fillet(rib_edges, fillet_radius)

    # --- Shell the whole part (all faces open) -----------------------------
    shell(p.part, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=list(p.part.faces()))

    # --- Mounting holes through the plate ----------------------------------
    for hx, hy in [(-hole_spacing / 2.0, hole_offset), (hole_spacing / 2.0, hole_offset)]:
        with Locations((rib_thickness / 2.0 + hx, plate_thickness / 2.0, hy)):

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dimensions (mm)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
handle_length = 80.0          # overall length of the handle
handle_width = 30.0           # overall width
handle_height = 20.0          # overall height (thickness)

wall_thickness = 3.0          # thin wall thickness
web_thickness = 4.0           # central web thickness
slot_width = 12.0             # width of the two through slots
slot_length = handle_length - 2 * wall_thickness
slot_offset = (handle_width - slot_width) / 2.0 - web_thickness / 2.0

chamfer_distance = 1.0        # chamfer on the two outer vertical edges
rib_thickness = 2.0           # internal longitudinal rib thickness
rib_height = handle_height - 2 * wall_thickness
rib_spacing = 15.0            # rib pitch along the length
rib_count = int((handle_length - 2 * wall_thickness) // rib_spacing) + 1

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build the handle
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
with BuildPart() as p:
    # Base body
    Box(handle_length, handle_width, handle_height)

    # Chamfer the two outer vertical edges (largest |X| corners)
    outer_edges = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z).sort_by(Axis.X)[-2:]
    chamfer(outer_edges, chamfer_distance)

    # Hollow the body -> thin-walled shell (open top & bottom faces)
    top_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    bottom_face = p.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[0]
    offset(p.part, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face, bottom_face])

    # Central longitudinal web (spans the cavity)
    Box(web_thickness, handle_width - 2 * wall_thickness, handle_height)

    # Two longitudinal through slots, mirrored about the web
    with Locations((0, slot_offset, 0), (0, -slot_offset, 0)):
        Box(slot_length, slot_width, handle_height, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)

    # Internal longitudinal ribs (additive), repeated along the length
    rib_length = handle_length - 2 * wall_thickness
    for i in range(rib_count):
        x_pos = (i - (rib_count - 1) / 2) * rib_spacing
        Pos(x_pos, 0, 0) * Box(rib_length, rib_thickness, rib_height)

part = p.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Export
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
export_step(part, "output.step")

from build123d import *
import math

# ---- dimensions (mm) ----
tube_outer_dia = 12.0          # hexagonal tube outer diameter
tube_wall = 1.5                # thin wall thickness
tube_length = 80.0             # length of each straight tube

# ---- five-point star geometry ----
star_outer_r = 40.0            # outer (point) radius of the star
star_inner_r = 18.0            # inner (valley) radius of the star
star_point_count = 5

def star_points(outer_r, inner_r, count):
    pts = []
    angle_step = math.pi / count
    for i in range(2 * count):
        r = outer_r if i % 2 == 0 else inner_r
        angle = i * angle_step
        pts.append((r * math.cos(angle), r * math.sin(angle)))
    return pts

star_pts = star_points(star_outer_r, star_inner_r, star_point_count)

# ---- build the star frame from five straight tubes ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    # straight hexagonal tube
    with BuildSketch() as s:
        RegularPolygon(tube_outer_dia / 2, 6)
    extrude(amount=tube_length)

    # place one tube along each edge of the star polygon
    for i in range(star_point_count):
        p0 = star_pts[i]
        p1 = star_pts[(i + 1) % star_point_count]
        dx = p1[0] - p0[0]
        dy = p1[1] - p0[1]
        angle_deg = math.degrees(math.atan2(dy, dx))
        # orient tube axis along the edge and shift to the edge midpoint
        tube = Rot(0, 0, angle_deg) * Pos(p0[0], p0[1], 0) * Box(tube_outer_dia, tube_length, tube_outer_dia)
        tube = Pos(0, dy / 2, 0) * tube
        add(tube)

part = p.part

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spherical-section (spherical-section) coupler / connecting rod
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# The rod is the solid of intersection of two equal spheres whose
# centres are spaced along the rod axis.  The intersection of two
# equal spheres is a common circle -> the rod has a constant circular
# cross-section, but its axis is a smooth S-curve passing through both
# centres, so the rod bends twice (a "dogbone" / lemniscate rod).
#
#   sphere radius (each end)      R      = 21.688
#   centre-to-centre length       L      = 53.375
#   rod cross-section diameter    d      = 10.112
#   rod cross-section radius      r      = 5.056
#   overall envelope diameter                 = 43.375
#   overall envelope length                   = 80.000
#
# Each sphere also carries a short coaxial cylindrical stub (same
# radius as the rod) which protrudes past the rod body and forms the
# coupling end of the part.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

R = 21.688          # sphere radius (each end)
L = 53.375          # centre-to-centre length
r = 5.056           # rod cross-section radius

stub_len = 12.0     # coupling-stub length beyond the rod body

# --- the rod: intersection of the two equal spheres -------------------
sphere_top = Pos(0, 0, L / 2) * Sphere(R)
sphere_bot = Pos(0, 0, -L / 2) * Sphere(R)
rod = sphere_top & sphere_bot

# --- coupling stubs (coaxial cylinders at each end) -------------------
stub_top = Pos(0, 0, L / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(r, stub_len)
stub_bot = Pos(0, 0, -L / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(r, stub_len)

part = rod + stub_top + stub_bot

export_step(part, "output.step")
